scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.fitai:start:tunnel:slow: pnpm --filter @workspace/fitai exec cross-env EXPO_TUNNEL_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 expo start --tunnel
scripts.fitai:start:tunnel:slow:clean: pnpm --filter @workspace/fitai exec cross-env EXPO_TUNNEL_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 expo start --tunnel --clear
